post.description:
A duplicate is a 409 (``duplicate_course``), a code or term that can't be a folder name a
422 (``invalid_course_code``, ``invalid_term``), both raised by ``Courses.add``.

get.description: Oldest upload first, the order the link step fills NotebookLM's slots in.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Courses  Course  Sources Get

post.description:
Store each file in its bucket (``bucket`` for all of them, else classified by name), then
queue one link job. An unknown bucket is a 422 before anything is stored; a file that can't
be stored (a name too long, say) is a 422 with the files before it stored and no link job
queued, which a retry of the link picks up.

409.description: A link job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

post.description:
The retry: the link step adds every stored file NotebookLM doesn't have yet and replaces
the stale ones, so running it again picks up whatever failed last time. While a link job is
already queued or running on the course, that job is returned rather than a second queued:
uploads are refused until it ends, so it has every stored file a second one would.

409 ``session_open`` while any session is open on the course (this server's, a CLI one,
or a stale one to close), 409 ``job_running`` during a seed or exam-create job.

409.description: A tutor session is open on the course (`session_open`; `session_id`, `stale`); or a seed or exam-create job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

get.description:
The live session, or null; on the interactive worker, the only thread that touches a
tutor.

schema.title: Response Get Session Api Courses  Course  Session Get

post.description:
One REPL line, exactly as ``brightlearn tutor`` reads it; ``/end`` ends the session.
A line the tutor couldn't answer is still a 200, with ``error`` saying why. A typed
``/ask q`` answers as the CLI's does, its citations listed in ``reply``; ``POST ask`` gives
them as data.
Ends the session and runs the Analyzer on its transcript, which can take minutes.

Inside a live session, the tutor's ``/ask`` in the session's own conversation. Otherwise a
fresh conversation, which deletes the course's latest one, so only when no session is open
and no seed or exam job is about to start one; and none can be submitted until it returns.

409.description: A tutor session is open on the course (`session_open`; `session_id`, `stale`); or a seed or exam-create job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Courses  Course  Sessions Get

get.description:
The Markdown transcript, also after ``maintain`` has archived it. Only ids with a row are
looked up, so the id can't name another file.

post.description:
Marks a session ended without running the Analyzer, as ``brightlearn sessions close``
does: for one whose tutor is gone (a crash, a restart, a CLI session). This server's live
session is a 409 ``session_live``: end it instead, which runs the Analyzer. Checked and
closed under the lock a session start holds from writing its row to registering its tutor,
so a session that is starting can't be closed before it shows as live.

409.description: The session is live in this server: end it instead (`session_live`; `session_id`)

get.description:
Active concepts unless asked: a retired one keeps its row, mastery and evidence but drops
out of every list (BL-040).

post.description:
The seed query starts a fresh NotebookLM conversation, which would end a live tutor's
(P66) or an ask's still being answered (P100): refuse now, under the lock a session start
and an ask take, so neither slips past the other.

409.description: A tutor session is open on the course (`session_open`; `session_id`, `stale`); or a question to the course's sources is being answered (`ask_running`)

schema.title: Response List Course Drafts Api Courses  Course  Concepts Drafts Get

put.description:
The review step: the learner's edit replaces the draft, as saving it in an editor would.
A draft apply couldn't load is refused (422) and the file is left as it was.

get.description:
A unified diff from the draft before this one ("" for the first), as the seed job showed
it, so the editor can show it again after a restart. It follows any edits since.

post.description:
Load a reviewed draft (the newest unless one is named); a draft still marked
``reviewed: false`` is a 422, like the CLI's refusal.

get.description: Newest first. A file that isn't an exam is skipped, not a 422 for the whole list.

schema.title: Response List Exams Api Courses  Course  Exams Get

post.description:
The spec is checked now (422), so a typo never waits behind a podcast. Its grounding
queries start fresh NotebookLM conversations (P66), so a course with an open tutor session,
or an ask still being answered (P100), is refused, under the lock a session start and an
ask take.

409.description: A tutor session is open on the course (`session_open`; `session_id`, `stale`); or a question to the course's sources is being answered (`ask_running`)

get.description:
A spec to start from, for the new-exam editor. Declared before ``/exams/{exam_id}``,
which would otherwise take "template" for an exam id (no exam file is named that).
The printable paper, answer key and rubrics included (after a rule).

The latest attempt as it stands, read only: unlike POST, it never opens an attempt, so
the take view can reload freely. The file is replaced whole on every write, so a read
never sees half of one.

post.description: Resume the unfinished attempt, or start the next one after a finished attempt.

409.description: A grade job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

post.description: Answer the current question; a multiple-choice reply that picks no option is a 422.

409.description: The exam has no unfinished attempt (`no_open_attempt`); or a grade job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)
The exam has no unfinished attempt (`no_open_attempt`); or a grade job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

post.description: Hand the attempt in; questions not answered yet are graded as skipped.

409.description: The exam has no unfinished attempt (`no_open_attempt`); or a grade job is queued or running on the course (`job_running`; `job_id`, `kind`)

post.description:
Only a handed-in attempt is queued (422 otherwise): a job the grader would refuse would
still hold up every take step on the course until its turn came, perhaps behind a podcast.
Checked under the lock the take steps hold, so the attempt can't change in between.

get.description:
The latest graded attempt, question by question with the reference answers, and per
concept as the file recorded it; 404 until an attempt is graded.

post.description:
``exam`` names an exam already created, looked up in the vault only: unlike the CLI's
``--exam``, never a spec file's path, since a web page has no business naming files here.
An unknown one is a 422 now, not a failed job twenty minutes from now. No session guard:
generating audio starts no conversation, as with the CLI.

AskOut.title: AskOut
AskOut.description:
A grounded answer and its citations. ``in_session``: asked in the live tutor session's
own conversation (its ``/ask``), which always asks every source.

ConceptOut.title: ConceptOut
ConceptOut.description: A concept and its mastery; one with no evidence yet reads as level 0.

DraftOut.title: DraftOut
DraftOut.description: A concept draft in the course's vault folder; ``latest`` is what apply loads by default.

ExamOut.title: ExamOut
ExamOut.description: An exam file's summary; no question text, so no answer can leak through it.

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description: A queued or finished job; the UI polls ``/api/jobs/{id}`` until ``done`` or ``failed``.

LiveSessionOut.title: LiveSessionOut
LiveSessionOut.description:
The tutor this server holds for a course. ``turns`` are the tutoring exchanges the
tutor remembers; probes, ``/ask`` answers and command replies are in the transcript.

ProbeOut.title: ProbeOut
ProbeOut.description: A Challenger question waiting for its answer: the next turn's text answers it.

ProviderHealthOut.title: ProviderHealthOut
ProviderHealthOut.description: What the top bar's health dots show: a cooldown says when a rate limit ends.

ProviderState.title: ProviderState
ProviderState.description: Health states, ordered from healthy to unusable.

ResultsOut.title: ResultsOut
ResultsOut.description: The latest graded attempt, read back from the exam file.

SessionOut.title: SessionOut
SessionOut.description:
A ``sessions`` row. ``stale`` is still open (it blocks its course) but idle long enough
to offer closing; ``live`` is set while this server holds its tutor (end it, don't close).

SourceOut.title: SourceOut
SourceOut.description: ``synced`` means stored, not in NotebookLM; ``linked`` says whether NotebookLM has it.

TakeOut.title: TakeOut
TakeOut.description:
Where the latest attempt stands. ``question`` is the next one to answer: null once the
attempt is handed in (``finished``), or when every question has an answer and it can be.
``attempt`` is null only before the exam was ever taken.

TextIn.title: TextIn
TextIn.description: A text file's new contents (a concept draft).

TextOut.title: TextOut
TextOut.description: A text file's contents: a transcript, a draft, its diff, an exam paper or a brief.

TurnErrorOut.title: TurnErrorOut
TurnErrorOut.description:
Why a line to the tutor got no answer, as a 502 body says it: the provider that failed
last (None when none was tried, or the persona had no concept to build on) and, for a rate
limit, the hint's reset time (e.g. ``3pm``).

TurnIn.title: TurnIn
TurnIn.description:
One line of the REPL: a question, or ``/persona x``, ``/rate n``, ``/skip``, ``/ask q``,
``/end``, ``/help``.

UploadOut.title: UploadOut
UploadOut.description: The stored files, and the link job that will send them to NotebookLM.
